Equality & Inclusion

Empowering Women Researchers Support

Practical, tangible initiatives designed to support female researchers in accelerating scientific careers while balancing family and professional commitments.

Stream 1: Competitive Funding

Earmarked Research Grants & Fellowships

Guaranteeing equitable representation across all UKABCS research awards.

Female PIs and early career researchers apply through standard peer-reviewed calls, with earmarked grant quotas guaranteeing equitable representation across all UKABCS capacity building and scientific software awards. Applications are evaluated under strict double-blind peer-review guidelines to ensure merit-driven selection.

Explore Open Grant Calls →
Stream 2: Family & Conference Support

Conference Childcare Subsidies & KidCamp Initiative

Enabling mother scientists to present international research without compromise.

UKABCS provides direct travel stipends and organized on-site childcare (KidCamp initiative) during UKABCS-sponsored conferences so mother scientists can present oral and poster papers without family compromise.

Apply for Women Researchers Support Form →
KidCamp Initiative

KidCamp Registration (Supporting Researcher Mothers)

UKABCS provides direct travel stipends and organized on-site childcare during scientific conferences so mother scientists can present oral and poster papers without family compromise. Register your children for certified, secure on-site childcare during UKABCS events.

Submit KidCamp Registration Form → Women Researchers Support Form →
Actionable Programs

6 Core Initiatives for Women in Science

Empowering female computational biologists with mentorship, fellowships, and practical career enablers.

01

Childcare & Conference Travel Subsidies

Direct financial stipends covering certified childcare expenses so mother scientists can present oral and poster papers at international conferences without family compromise.

02

Re-entry Research Fellowships

Targeted bridging grants and computational resources for female scholars resuming scientific research following maternity, caregiving, or family career breaks.

03

Women in STEM Academic Mentorship

Pairing early-career female researchers and doctoral candidates with senior women research directors and PIs across UK and international laboratories.

04

Laboratory Leadership & PI Workshops

Executive training modules on research grant negotiation, dry/wet lab resource allocation, patent filings, and managing multi-institutional consortia.

05

Keynote Parity & Research Visibility

Enforcing guaranteed gender parity across invited keynote speakers, session chairs, and scientific panels in all UKABCS co-sponsored symposiums.

06

Double-Blind Peer Review Grant Policy

Eliminating unconscious bias in all funding and software allocation decisions through mandatory institutional anonymization during peer review.
